author: Jpflame517
quote: This game looks amazing the graphics are top tier and all the animations so great but then when you find out your not able to kill all npcs is crazy the whole point of gta was to do whatever you wanted commit crime kill ppl blow things up have fun and cause chaos in your own open world sandbox but now it is not okay to kill certain npcs and its not because they are critical to the story no its because its deemed morally wrong in the game thats all about being as morally wrong or as morally correct as you choose to be. They even added a system where you can choose to kill or incapacitate your enemies which could make for some cool choices and how you wanna go about playing the game but then to be forced to not be able to get hookers or kill npcs is just mind boggling 13 years so I can have my politically correct game… mind you the last game you had Trevor one of the craziest characters of all time. This is sad
